csrfCookie.description: HttpOnly CSRF cookie paired with the masked request token.
csrfCookie.name: godj_csrf

csrfHeader.description: Masked token obtained from an authenticated safe response.
csrfHeader.name: X-Godj-Csrftoken

get.description: Returns at most 20 tickets in the application's selected category, ordered by ascending identifier. The response is a bare array. Query parameters are ignored.

X-Godj-Csrftoken.description: Fresh masked CSRF token on authenticated safe handler responses; reuse with the HttpOnly CSRF cookie for unsafe methods.

500.description: Internal server error. Internal causes are not exposed.

post.description: The application assigns the selected category and checks its existence within the create transaction. Authentication, CSRF when required, and permission checks precede body parsing; input validation precedes the category lookup.

requestBody.description: The body must be one JSON object, limited to 4096 bytes and depth 16. The JSON string limit is 65536 bytes, subject to the smaller whole-body limit. Duplicate members and trailing data are rejected. Subject is required. Omitted closed defaults to false; omitted details and priority become null. Empty details is distinct from null. Priority is a signed int64, and zero is distinct from null. Text is trimmed. The generated id and assigned category cannot be supplied.

400.description: The body cannot be parsed or a supplied field is invalid.

404.description: The application's selected category no longer exists.

415.description: The request Content-Type is not supported application/json.

500.description: Internal server error. Internal causes are not exposed.

get.description: The identifier must be positive. The selected category is fixed by the application. Viewing a ticket includes its category identity and name; a separate category-view permission is not required. Authentication and permission checks precede the joined lookup.

parameters.description: A canonical non-negative int64 decimal path segment. Invalid spellings are not routed.
parameters.name: id

200.description: The ticket and its category summary.

404.description: The ticket does not exist in the selected category or its identifier is not positive.
